meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成首次设置,跑通核心流程。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚拿到 omo,不知道第一步该做什么。
copy.tagline_en: Finish first-time setup and run through the core workflow.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just got omo and don't know the first step.

howto.what: 它是新用户与 omo 的第一次对话引导:按顺序走六个环节——功能介绍、迁移旧配置、翻阅你以往的编码会话、估算缓存省下的花费、随手记录关于你的持久信息、首个会话的 init-deep 建议。
howto.when: 新用户第一次要求上手 omo 时自动启动一次,且仅此一次;之后可用 `senpi --onboard` 手动唤回,或用 `omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled` 关闭自动启动。

say.text: 我想开始用 omo,带我走一遍上手流程
say.note: 进入六个环节的首次引导

say.text: 我从 Claude Code 过来,帮我把配置迁移过来
say.note: 先给出迁移方案,等你确认才动手

say.text: 看看我以前编码会话,估算缓存能省多少
say.note: 读本地会话日志并给出估算数字

howto.what_en: It turns a new user's first conversation into an onboarding walkthrough of six lanes in order: feature tour, migration from another agent, session archaeology, savings estimates, ongoing memory recording, and an init-deep proposal.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new user asks to get started with omo; it auto-starts once, ever. Bring it back with the `senpi --onboard` flag, or disable auto-start with `omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled`.

say_en.text: I want to start using omo — walk me through getting set up.
I'm coming from Claude Code; help me migrate my setup.
say_en.note: Presents a migration plan and waits for your OK

say_en.text: Look through my past coding sessions and estimate the caching savings.
say_en.note: Reads session logs and gives an estimate
